subject: MAP: security gates & DPA timeline — Pinebridge close plan
messages:
From: Michael Turner <m.turner@pinebridge.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elaine Cho <elaine.cho@pinebridge.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Jun 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: security gates and DPA timeline for June close

Vanessa —

Thanks for the demo last week. Procurement asked me to confirm the mutual action plan (MAP) and the security acceptance gates so we can hit our target close window (end of June). Two quick asks from my side:

1) Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide a SOC 2 Type II attestation and the latest SIG/CAIQ inventory by the dates below? Our security team needs the attestation and the CAIQ responses to complete their assessment.

2) We need a draft DPA redline (key commercial/legal points below) and confirmation of standard data retention windows (logs, backups, user data).

Target constraints from Pinebridge:
- Close target: by 2026-06-30 (contract executed)
- Security checklist sign-off no later than 2026-06-18
- DPA redline returned to us for routing to procurement by 2026-06-12

Key DPA points we care about: encryption in transit and at rest, DSAR process, deletion at termination, and whether you offer EU residency for data (we have EU customers).

If you can send a short MAP with milestones and owners, we’ll route internally. Happy to jump on a short call if that helps.

Thanks —
Michael Turner
Senior IT Risk Manager
Pinebridge Financial
Michael.Turner@pinebridge.com
+1 415-555-0134
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Michael Turner <m.turner@pinebridge.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: security gates and DPA timeline for June close

Michael —

Appreciate the clarity. We can definitely support a June close; below is a concise MAP we’ll execute on with owners and dates. I attached a one‑page MAP timeline (MAP_timeline_v3.xlsx) for your procurement and security teams.

Proposed MAP (high level)
- 2026-06-04: Redwood provides SOC 2 Type II attestation (latest available PDF) — owner: Compliance (Kimberly).
- 2026-06-08: SIG/CAIQ completed and spreadsheet delivered — owner: Security (Kimberly).
- 2026-06-09: Redwood legal sends DPA redline for Pinebridge review — owner: Legal (Rachel).
- 2026-06-12: Pinebridge returns DPA comments to Redwood / routing to procurement contact — owner: Procurement (Michael / Elaine).
- 2026-06-18: Security acceptance sign-off (final open items resolved) — owner: Pinebridge security + Redwood security.
- 2026-06-22: Final contract clean copy for signature / DocuSign — owner: Legal/procurement.

Actions for Pinebridge (quick)
- Please confirm procurement contact (I’ve CC’d Rachel and Kimberly so they can start the DPA and technical Q&A).
- If Pinebridge needs EU residency, flag it now — it changes hosting options (hosted vs dedicated/private) and may affect the DPA language.

We’ll attach the SOC 2 attestation and the CAIQ answers with the next email. If anything is blocking for you, call me and we’ll triage.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Michael Turner <m.turner@pinebridge.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 03 Jun 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: security gates and DPA timeline for June close — SOC2/CAIQ scope + retention notes

Michael / Vanessa —

Quick note from security / compliance to clarify scope and expected turnarounds so Pinebridge can plan reviewers:

SOC 2- Scope: production inference hosting, model artifacts storage, and telemetry (no third-party managed data processors in scope). We can provide the SOC 2 Type II attestation (redacted where required) by 2026-06-04 as Vanessa noted.

SIG / CAIQ- We’ll deliver the completed CAIQ spreadsheet and a short answer memo by 2026-06-08. Expect granular answers on encryption, key management, network segmentation, and operational controls. If you need additional evidence (e.g., control narratives) flag specific sections and we’ll prioritize.

DPA / Data retention (default options & notes)- Default retention windows (standard offering):
  • Audit logs / request logs: 90 days (can extend to 1 year on request for merchant customers)
  • Backups / snapshots: 7 years (industrial‑strength backup retention policy)
  • Customer data (user content used for inference): customer‑configurable; default = 2 years unless contract specifies otherwise
  • KV cache / ephemeral caches: kept only for inference lifetime (tied to session TTL)

If Pinebridge requires EU residency for customer data, we can support via Dedicated or Private deployments — that will be reflected in the DPA (data flow and subprocessors sections).

Security turnaround expectations- CAIQ: 2–3 business days to answer, follow-ups for evidence may take additional 3–5 days depending on scope.

I attached a simple SOC2_scope_matrix.csv that maps the controls to our deployment artifacts — use it to focus your reviewers.

Kimberly Park
Head of Security & Compliance — Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: SOC2_scope_matrix.csv

Subject: Re: MAP: security gates & DPA timeline — Pinebridge close plan

Vanessa / Kimberly —

Thanks for the fast turnaround and the MAP timeline — that looks workable. A few quick confirmations from procurement side before we route to signature:

• Procurement contact: Elaine Cho (elaine.cho@pinebridge.com) — I’ve CC’d her here.
• Deal id for procurement: PB-2026-1342. Please include that in the DPA redline filename.
• DSAR / deletion: we need explicit language that upon termination Pinebridge can request deletion of customer data and that backups will be expired according to the agreed retention window (please include a deletion SLA if possible).

Next steps for us: we’ll queue the CAIQ review this week and expect to have a single consolidated list of follow-ups by 2026-06-14. Please send the DPA redline to Elaine and I by 2026-06-12 so procurement can route internally.

If you can provide the DocuSign envelope once the DPA is agreed (or a DocuSign test URL to verify fields), that would be ideal.

Best —
Michael Turner
Senior IT Risk Manager
Pinebridge Financial
